rows.why: She had just taught متشجع (motivated); he said شجاع (brave), the same root in the wrong form, and she recast متشجع.

rows.why: متشجع takes لـ, not عشان; she said لا then 'It takes لا', typed 'mitshajje3 + la', and he accepted ('just a لا').

rows.medi_said: أنا كنت بهمس. أنا كنت أهمس.
rows.why: He made a verb-like بهمس/أهمس (whisper) for the adjective متحمس (sheet: excited | mit7ammes); she recast كنت متحمس and he said 'Yeah, that's right'.

rows.medi_said: How do I say customers I was excited for?
rows.why: He asked how to say 'excited for them'; she supplied متحمس إلهم.
متحمس takes لـ (sheet: متحمس لَ) and the ending on la- is ilhom; he said إنهم, she recast إلهم.

rows.medi_said: It would be جابت؟ بجيب، جابت.
rows.why: Past 'I brought' is جبت (short e), not جابت (she brought); she recast جبت and explained 'E's turn into short E's'.
After 11+ the noun is singular (سجادة), not the collective سجاد; she recast سجادة (he repeated it at 10:05 - one row).

He said مواعد (plural form) for one appointment; she recast the singular موعد (sheet: appointment | Maw3ed).

rows.amal_said: So we say من الأسبوع الماضي.

Repeating her line he dropped el- on the noun before الماضي (noun + definite adjective both take el-); her chat has el-usboo3 el-maadi but she voiced nothing.
